description: The line plot, titled "Performance w.r.t. Temperature," illustrates the relationship between accuracy (measured as Pass@8) and temperature for three different methods: On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT. The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," ranges from 0.1 to 1.0 on a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)," ranges from 62.5 to 80.0, also on a linear scale. The On-policy RL method, represented by a yellow line with triangle markers, starts at an accuracy of approximately 64.5 at a temperature of 0.1, increases to a peak of about 75.0 at a temperature of 0.8, and then decreases to 73.5 at a temperature of 1.0. The LUFFY method, shown with a red line and star markers, begins at an accuracy of 75.5 at a temperature of 0.1, fluctuates with a peak of 80.0 at a temperature of 0.9, and ends at 80.5 at a temperature of 1.0. The SFT method, depicted with a teal line and downward-pointing triangle markers, starts at an accuracy of 75.5 at a temperature of 0.1, dips to a minimum of 70.0 at a temperature of 0.5, and then rises to 74.5 at a temperature of 1.0.
